hints.title: Sorted Citation Threshold Obstacle
hints.text: The citations array is already sorted in ascending order. How can you find the inflection point where paper citation count matches or exceeds remaining paper count?

hints.title: H-Index Monotonic Invariant
hints.text: For any index mid, there are n - mid papers with at least citations[mid] citations. If citations[mid] >= n - mid, candidate h is at least n - mid, so look left.

hints.title: Ascending Threshold Bisection Procedure
hints.text: Set left = 0, right = n - 1. While left <= right, compute mid = (left + right) // 2. If citations[mid] >= n - mid, search left by setting right = mid - 1; otherwise set left = mid + 1. Return n - left.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Logarithmic bisection on presorted citation array in O(1) space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear scan through citations takes O(N) which misses the logarithmic optimization possible on sorted inputs.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expressing h-index as n - mid and checking the condition citations[mid] >= n - mid.
